nativeHelperSelftest.classification: Real Windows audio capture of owned synthetic-tone processes; not Roblox Studio or ASMR evaluation
nativeHelperSelftest.observationSource: bridge_recovery agent terminal selftest report; summarized measurements, raw WAV removed by selftest cleanup

limitations: Final app discovery found no Studio and no loaded model key.
Provider and Studio integration tests use controlled doubles and do not establish live compatibility.
Audio capture requires Windows, one selected Studio/process, a quiet baseline and short owned sound playback.
Selected Gemini/OpenRouter evaluator model must support audio; provider support alone does not prove model support.
Capture isolates the Studio process tree, not every individual Sound within it.
Full-game interactions, animation, audiovisual timing and quality require separate native verification.

pythonAudit.mitigation: AGENTS.md prohibits bare Python alias probes; use verified bundled runtime paths only if needed for a separate task.
